CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS asolaria_control;

I can help you understand this SQL statement for SingleStore.

This command creates a new database named asolaria_control if it doesn't already exist. The IF NOT EXISTS clause prevents an error if a database with that name is already present.

To execute this in SingleStore, you can:

Connect to your SingleStore workspace using a MySQL-compatible client
Run the command directly:
CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS asolaria_control;

After creation, you can switch to this database with:

USE asolaria_control;

This is a standard SQL command that works in both SingleStore Helios and SingleStore Self-Managed. Once created, you can start defining tables, loading data, and running queries within this database.
